# launchpad-registry

> Open, community-maintained registry of token launchpads (program IDs, factories, Uniswap V4 hooks, multi-tenant configs, launch events) on Solana and EVM chains. Data is CC0, code is MIT.

## Data (JSON, no auth)
- All launchpads: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/launchpad-registry/main/dist/launchpads.json
- Slim list (ids + addresses): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/launchpad-registry/main/dist/launchpads.min.json
- Reverse index chain:address → launchpad: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/launchpad-registry/main/dist/addresses.json
- CSV: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/launchpad-registry/main/dist/launchpads.csv
- Schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/launchpad-registry/main/schema/launchpad.schema.json

## Key concepts
- `chain.family` is `solana` or `evm`; EVM chains are keyed by chainId, directories are `evm-<chainId>`; `caip2` is provided.
- `contracts[].role`: program | factory | launcher | hook | curve | platform-config | partner-config | deployer | authority | token | other.
- `builtOn` links a branded frontend (letsbonk) to its multi-tenant program (raydium-launchlab).
- `launch` describes how one launch appears on-chain (instruction name + Anchor discriminator, or ABI event + topic0, and which field carries the new token).
- `status`: active | inactive | test | unknown. `checked` = last on-chain verification date. `lastActivity` = automated liveness.

## Tools
- npm package `launchpad-registry` exports `lookup(chain, address)`, `isKnown`, `forChain`, `frontendsOf`, `active`.
- `detector/` finds unregistered launchpads from an RPC and posts alerts.
- `mcp/` exposes the registry to AI agents over MCP (tools: lookup, search, get, list_chains).
